WITH claimed AS (
    UPDATE ingestion.sync_checkpoints sc
    SET
        checkpoint_status = 'running',
        claimed_run_id = $1::BIGINT,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE sc.entity_key = $5::TEXT
      AND sc.checkpoint_status = 'ready'
      AND sc.claimed_run_id IS NULL
      AND sc.last_watermark = $3::TIMESTAMPTZ
      AND sc.last_primary_key = $4::TEXT
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM ingestion.sync_runs sr
          WHERE sr.run_id = $1::BIGINT
            AND sr.run_status = 'running'
            AND sr.sync_scope = $5::TEXT
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM ingestion.sync_run_entities sre
          WHERE sre.entity_run_id = $2::BIGINT
            AND sre.run_id = $1::BIGINT
            AND sre.entity_key = $5::TEXT
            AND sre.entity_status = 'running'
      )
    RETURNING
        sc.entity_key,
        sc.source_database,
        sc.source_schema,
        sc.source_table,
        sc.target_schema,
        sc.target_table,
        sc.primary_key_column,
        sc.watermark_column,
        sc.last_watermark::text AS last_watermark,
        sc.last_primary_key,
        sc.checkpoint_status,
        sc.claimed_run_id
)
SELECT
    $1::BIGINT AS run_id,
    $2::BIGINT AS entity_run_id,
    $5::TEXT AS entity_key,
    c.source_database,
    c.source_schema,
    c.source_table,
    c.target_schema,
    c.target_table,
    c.primary_key_column,
    c.watermark_column,
    c.last_watermark,
    c.last_primary_key,
    COALESCE(c.checkpoint_status, 'not_claimed') AS checkpoint_status,
    c.claimed_run_id,
    (c.entity_key IS NOT NULL) AS checkpoint_claimed,
    'entity_checkpoint_claim_attempted'::TEXT AS workflow_stage
FROM (SELECT 1 AS anchor) a
LEFT JOIN claimed c ON TRUE;

WITH changed AS (
    SELECT
        rep_id,
        full_name,
        email,
        team,
        manager_id,
        region,
        employment_status,
        hire_date,
        monthly_quota_default,
        source_created_at,
        source_updated_at
    FROM crm.sales_reps
    WHERE $5::TEXT = 'crm.sales_reps'
      AND (
          source_updated_at > $3::TIMESTAMPTZ
          OR (
              source_updated_at = $3::TIMESTAMPTZ
              AND rep_id > $4::TEXT
          )
      )
    ORDER BY source_updated_at, rep_id
    LIMIT 100
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS rows_extracted,
        COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                to_jsonb(c)
                ORDER BY c.source_updated_at, c.rep_id
            ),
            '[]'::JSONB
        ) AS changed_rows
    FROM changed c
),
last_row AS (
    SELECT source_updated_at, rep_id
    FROM changed
    ORDER BY source_updated_at DESC, rep_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    $1::BIGINT AS run_id,
    $2::BIGINT AS entity_run_id,
    $5::TEXT AS entity_key,
    $3::TEXT AS start_watermark,
    $4::TEXT AS start_primary_key,
    a.rows_extracted,
    a.changed_rows,
    lr.source_updated_at::text AS candidate_end_watermark,
    lr.rep_id AS candidate_end_primary_key,
    (a.rows_extracted > 0) AS changes_found,
    'entity_source_extraction_complete'::TEXT AS workflow_stage
FROM aggregated a
LEFT JOIN last_row lr ON TRUE;

WITH released AS (
    UPDATE ingestion.sync_checkpoints sc
    SET
        checkpoint_status = 'ready',
        claimed_run_id = NULL,
        last_synced_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE sc.entity_key = $5::TEXT
      AND sc.checkpoint_status = 'running'
      AND sc.claimed_run_id = $1::BIGINT
      AND sc.last_watermark = $3::TIMESTAMPTZ
      AND sc.last_primary_key = $4::TEXT
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM ingestion.sync_runs sr
          WHERE sr.run_id = $1::BIGINT
            AND sr.run_status = 'running'
            AND sr.sync_scope = $5::TEXT
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM ingestion.sync_run_entities sre
          WHERE sre.entity_run_id = $2::BIGINT
            AND sre.run_id = $1::BIGINT
            AND sre.entity_key = $5::TEXT
            AND sre.entity_status = 'running'
      )
    RETURNING sc.entity_key, sc.last_watermark::text AS last_watermark, sc.last_primary_key
),
entity_done AS (
    UPDATE ingestion.sync_run_entities
    SET
        start_watermark = $3::TIMESTAMPTZ,
        start_primary_key = $4::TEXT,
        end_watermark = $3::TIMESTAMPTZ,
        end_primary_key = $4::TEXT,
        rows_extracted = 0,
        rows_upserted = 0,
        entity_status = 'succeeded',
        error_message = NULL,
        completed_at = NOW()
    WHERE entity_run_id = $2::BIGINT
      AND run_id = $1::BIGINT
      AND entity_key = $5::TEXT
      AND entity_status = 'running'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM released)
    RETURNING entity_run_id
),
run_done AS (
    UPDATE ingestion.sync_runs
    SET
        run_status = 'succeeded',
        completed_at = NOW(),
        rows_extracted = 0,
        rows_upserted = 0,
        rows_rejected = 0,
        error_message = NULL,
        run_metadata = run_metadata || jsonb_build_object(
            'result', 'no_changes',
            'entity_key', $5::TEXT,
            'checkpoint_advanced', false,
            'checkpoint_released', true
        )
    WHERE run_id = $1::BIGINT
      AND run_status = 'running'
      AND sync_scope = $5::TEXT
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entity_done)
    RETURNING run_id
)
SELECT
    $1::BIGINT AS run_id,
    $2::BIGINT AS entity_run_id,
    $5::TEXT AS entity_key,
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM released) AS checkpoint_released,
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM entity_done) AS entity_completed,
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM run_done) AS run_completed,
    false AS checkpoint_advanced,
    ($3::TIMESTAMPTZ)::text AS retained_watermark,
    $4::TEXT AS retained_primary_key,
    'no_change_entity_sync_completed'::TEXT AS workflow_stage;

    SELECT

        sc.last_successful_run_id,

        CASE
          WHEN sc.checkpoint_status='running'
           AND sc.claimed_run_id=$1::BIGINT
           AND sc.last_watermark=$3::TIMESTAMPTZ
           AND sc.last_primary_key=$4::TEXT
          THEN 'owned_old_cursor'
          WHEN sc.checkpoint_status='ready'
           AND sc.claimed_run_id IS NULL
           AND sc.last_watermark=$6::TIMESTAMPTZ
           AND sc.last_primary_key=$7::TEXT
           AND sc.last_successful_run_id=$1::BIGINT
          THEN 'committed_new_cursor'
          ELSE 'unexpected_state'
        END AS reconciliation_case
    FROM ingestion.sync_checkpoints sc
    JOIN ingestion.sync_runs sr ON sr.run_id=$1::BIGINT
    JOIN ingestion.sync_run_entities sre
      ON sre.entity_run_id=$2::BIGINT AND sre.run_id=$1::BIGINT AND sre.entity_key=$5::TEXT
